dct_description_sm: # Taiwan Earthquake: Damage Proxy Maps, Apr 2024 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Taiwan Earthquake (Apr 2024) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Taiwan, Earthquake, 04 Apr 2024, v0.5 wbd** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Taiwan, Earthquake, 04 Apr 2024, v0.5 wbd** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Taiwan, Earthquake, 04 Apr 2024, v0.5** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Taiwan, Earthquake, 04 Apr 2024, v0.5** (superseded) **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Original data ALOS-2 PALSAR-2 Product - JAXA (2022-2024)
